received_works.body:
Hello, my name is Aikiku Akazuki, and I am a Vtuber.
I am a Vtuber, and I would like to ask you to do an illustration for me.


I would be happy to leave the composition to you. I would like it to have a stylish, cute, yet cool atmosphere!


I would appreciate it if you could provide me with transparent background data for the characters only, for commercial use ✨.


Thank you very much for your time.


I plan to use it for commercial purposes.
I would also like to receive transparent background data for the characters only,

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Hello. I was wondering if you could draw this character.

https://skeb.jp/@gengerv3/works/35
https://skeb.jp/@gengerv3/works/36

Feel free to decide the details. Thank you for the consideration.

Hello マカロんぱ-san, 

I really like your artstyle.  Would you be willing to draw my character,  Rose? 

Rose is a cat girl who loves flowers, butterflies,  and lace. 
Her color palette consists of reds, pinks, and whites. 
 
Character Reference:  https://imgur.com/a/4U5UHxV

Thank you for your time and consideration..!

Hi, thank you for your appeal.
Please draw my OC Mei. She is a demon who is quiet and lonely. She has elf ears, black horns, black wings, and a gold halo and accessories. Her hair is white, and the ends are red. She likes to fly in the sky during night time.
I leave pose and expression to you. I may use this on other SNS sites. I will give you credit. If possible, please include a version with a transparent background. If possible, please make the size 1920 x 1080, you can choose vertically or horizontally. 

Here is a reference I drew. The right side is more correct. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-99aOpTg1jwg4k_i5UKvMcYs8SdxPLnv

Thank you very much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-99aOpTg1jwg4k_i5UKvMcYs8SdxPLnv

Hi - I absolutely love the way you draw faces so I wanted to try sending a request! I was wondering if you'd be willing to draw one of my FFXIV characters - she's an Elezen white mage with short dark hair and green eyes.

You can draw her however you like but I'd love if she was wearing the white/red robes from the reference images! (Moonward healing set)

https://imgur.com/a/UETtLqB
https://skeb.jp/@mmmofuni/works/4
https://skeb.jp/@mmmofuni/works/8
https://skeb.jp/@kamu_kotan/works/77

Feel free to cancel if you're not interested or if there are any issues with my request. Thanks for considering!

Hi!  I was hoping you would draw one of my ttrpg characters.  She is like a Witcher with Slavic/Norse themes. She uses a giant dual sided axe and is very focused and intelligent. Her eyes are pink and her hair is noric blonde, please feel free to draw freely!

Thank you for the consideration!

https://imgur.com/a/vaqC7sM

Hello! I'd like to request art of my Vtuber character, Riinah.
It will be used on SNS (Twitter/Twitch/etc.)
Riinah's a demon with a "dream" theme.

REQUEST:

1. Draw her however you like!

https://twitter.com/RiinahLucidVT/status/1576786703024431105
https://twitter.com/miisu1121/status/1586343697566007296

Hello, I loved what you did for this piece https://skeb.jp/@maka_ronpa/works/5

May I get a drawing of my persona in a similar way?
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1wtJLPWhaXhvNOp_CYufghXC2ZUwF6tm0?usp=share_link

Gender: Female
Age: Unknown
Height: 152.4CM
Chest: B cup

Information: She is an astronaut in search of life. She wears a hat with cat ears :). The cat ears are not real, but they are fluffy. She is a comfy and soft person. She likes the stars and outer space!

Thank you so much for your consideration and I hope you have a wonderful time drawing her!

Hello, I saw your appeal. I would like to request that you draw my original character.

Reference: https://imgur.com/a/BcPRfC5

She is someone who has been corrupted by evil. Her personality is arrogant, smug, and cruel. Her theme includes roses, rose thorns, ink, chains, hourglasses, and clocks.

Pose and background is up to you but I would like her to be smiling. I would like the outfit to stay the same

I like the way you draw eyes, so if possible I would like her blindfold half on half off (see the fourth image in my references). Please include the ink streaks going down her face. 

Thank you for considering my request.

Hello, thank you for your appeal! I've looked through your twitter, your art is so beautiful, I'm honored! I'm glad you like my character Lumen so much!

Lumen is a mage, proficient in elemental magical. She is a tall (185cm) and strong tomboy. She has red eyes, short black bobbed hair that curls at the ends, freckles, a mole under her eye, one on under the right corner of her lip, and one on her breast. 

Please draw her however you like, and be as creative as you'd like! Thank you for your time!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CTZ0G1Z6AQr2f_yzFdQKezSbiyYdRlfe?usp=sharing

Hello I love your art style, and would love it if you were to draw my FFXIV character Iris. Iris is a bubbly big sister type, who is sporty, cute, and very confident in herself.  Could you draw her in her jacket and dress outfit? I leave the rest of the composition up to you.

Thank you for your consideration.  Can I also request a version with the addressee and a version without the addressee?

https://imgur.com/a/tfRV0GS

Hello! Thank you for the appeal! I'm glad you like my VTuber!

She is the embodiment of dreams and nightmares! She takes form as a witch with six eyes who grants wishes to people in exchange for their lives and stories, which she then turns into stardust that she keeps in her hourglasses!
She has a calm, cool, serious, yet caring personality similar to a big sister!
References: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1_Hy5dG78V7GRp38SXH0OeCul2A1j6gBx
Her bangs are straight and stop right above the top set of her eyes; none of her eyes should be covered!

Here are some references of my current design if that helps with body type! 
https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/13EmdRIDS-LlTcirYss_KcnCDqCv07lpy

The pose and expression are up to you, please separate the character from the background in the PSD if you include one!

This will be used on SNS and Twitch with credits to you!
Thank you so much!

Hello and thank you for the appeal!

Here are some references, you can choose the outfit:

White swimsuit:
https://imgur.com/a/cHhh7Mn

Purple shirt:
https://imgur.com/a/g3KLyki


Please draw her in any way in like!

Thank you!

Hello! Your art style is very attractive! Please draw my original character, Hahzel, in her new green dress! Any pose or situation!

https://imgur.com/a/HCb6LcW (new dress)

https://imgur.com/a/uL1YBJg (original reference)

Thank you for taking me into consideration! I'd love if you could appeal my request about drawing the character Wraith in Apex Legends with the skin "Void Walker". I want to use this artwork as my background of my phone.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YUROzg0fBJDg9XTGtnqdzoGKtvhSYwTe/view?usp=sharing
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mqag8zCVKc-vtpVOQyPVXPVt97Bid4fN/view?usp=sharing
I am hoping that she does not cover her face with her helmet, she is a beauty without her helmet so I hope to see her with the suit of "Void Walker" but without her helmet! Also, I'd love to have her heirloom——Kunai in her hand! Instead of the words "QUIETO", I want to have the words "NEO" Instead 
Here is the link
https://drive.google.com/file/d/17ibz82jMWgVMhmIs3iP3W7oOFUdQfCVA/view?usp=sharing
it is appreciated if you can make the style as one of your work below and make her look younger! Thank you!
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E-gUK5rUYAUN-P3?format=jpg&name=900x900

Thank you for your appeal!
We'd love to have you work with us, and we'd like you to work with our child!
The character image will be a princess.
The character image will be a princess, and I hope you can draw her as you like, while referring to past SS and works!
I hope you will consider it!

Hello there! I think your art is beautiful. I'd love it if you could draw my character, Yua. 

Yua is a charismatic, friendly and very caring person. She looks out for everyone as if they're family, and will do a lot to make others happy and cared for. She's very motherly in nature. Her fangs make her look mischievous, but she's kind. For the pose, I was hoping I could get her holding a large sunflower while smiling.

Thank you! ^^

https://imgur.com/a/zdyFgE0

Draw my spirit/personality in hatsune miku's body (lol so embarrassing) rolls over in grave*

anyway feel free to change miku's clothing, hairstyle, accessories to fit what you think I would do as her better, but keep the colors to Miku's palette. I like the proportions of Redjuice's world is mine Miku in link
For outfit requests
-either knee-high socks, stockings, or tights
-wearing high top jordans

Other than that use your knowledge of the things I like and your interactions with me to do what you think is best I trust your judgment more than mine when it comes to composition and expressions 

TLDR on me for a reminder
-music(DJ/Producer,edm, hip/hop vocaloid/kpop/pop).
-geek(gamer/esports/likes anime/tech computers)
-animals(sloths/cats/cute things)
-cars (Classic Japanese sports cars ae86/180sx)
-artist(likes to sketch doodle)
-would cosplay if i was girl(maid,cat, seifuku)

even if it is just subtle hints please try to include some aspects here and there

sorry for being so needy

https://www.deviantart.com/redjuice999/art/World-is-Mine-1-87712507

こんばんは！マカロんぱさんの作品に一目惚れしてしまいました。ご依頼したいのはTwitterのアイコンです。
描いて頂きたいのはワットソンで、スキンはアクセル全開で、バストアップでお願い致します。
そしてかっこいい/クール/強気なイメージで、表情やポーズなどはお任せします。よろしくお願い致します(_ _*))

Your art is amazing! Can you draw my friend's original character in your style? Their name is Hiroe and they are the 932nd reincarnation of the hero. I will leave everything up to you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qUabEQdXGtbYXzdyizP34e-lmg0XE2xJ?usp=sharing

I'd like to request an illustration of my child (my VRchat avatar).

Please leave all the poses, etc. to me.

I would appreciate it if you could allow me to use it on youtube, etc. for personal viewing and other uses than SNS.

Thank you for your consideration.

https://3d.nicovideo.jp/works/td75626
